desc: Derive prefix sums and verify cost formula expansion: dp[j][r] = (S[r]+k*j)*C[r] + min_l { dp[j-1][l-1] - (S[r]+k*j)*C[l-1] } as lines with slope -C[l-1], intercept dp[j-1][l-1], queried at x = S[r]+k*j.
Choose CHT variant: monotone CHT valid since C increasing → slopes -C[l-1] decreasing in insertion order, and S increasing → queries x = S[r]+k*j increasing in r; O(n) per j.
Implement DP with monotone CHT per j; answer = min over j of dp[j][n]; base case dp_prev[0]=0; lazy line insertion (next_l pointer) so all l <= i-1 are present when querying i.
Test against both provided examples (110 and 985) plus 300 random small cases cross-validated against O(n^3) brute force; edge cases n=1 verified.
Confirm complexity O(n^2) time / O(n) memory fits n<=1000 (~10^6 operations); values fit in Python ints.
